Introduction

GOOD DAY was a South Korean girl group formed by C9 Entertainment. They debuted on August 30, 2017, with the title track was 'Rolly'. On November 1, 2019, they officially disbanded.

After the group's disbandment, all members went on to re-debut in different groups. Chaesol, Jiwon, YeAh, Viva, and Lucky all became members of the girl group cignature under J9 Entertainment, a subsidiary of C9 Entertainment.

Meanwhile, Genie, Cherry, Nayoon, and Yehyeon all left C9 Entertainment and signed with Mellow Entertainment, re-debuting in the girl group REDSQUARE, which was later rebranded to IRRIS.
